headlines.title: Investors Are Pushing Into Tobacco Stocks as Rate Concerns Return. What That Means for Altria.
headlines.summary: Investors are pushing into tobacco stocks after the 10-year Treasury yield hit 5.36%, its highest level in 24 years, lifting Altria stock after an August dividend increase of 4.7% to $1.11 per share.

headlines.title: PM vs. MO: Which Tobacco Dividend to Trust for the Next Decade
headlines.summary: Both tobacco giants just raised their dividends and both stocks are up over 28% this year, but the one paying nearly twice the yield may actually be the riskier bet for retirees building income over the next decade.

headlines.title: Ready to Retire and Want $7,500 a Year in Passive Income? Invest $25,000 in Each of These 5 Dividend Stocks
headlines.summary: When the paycheck stops at retirement, your portfolio has to carry the weight, and one dividend cut can force painful choices between a tighter budget and selling shares at the worst moment. These five stocks were chosen to avoid exactly that fate.

headlines.title: Altria (MO) Rises As Market Takes a Dip: Key Facts
headlines.summary: Altria (MO) closed the most recent trading day at $69.38, moving +1.21% from the previous trading session.

headlines.title: 2 Reasons to Like MO and 1 to Stay Skeptical
headlines.summary: Altria has been treading water for the past six months, recording a small return of 3.3% while holding steady at $68.46. The stock also fell short of the S&P 500’s 17.5% gain during that period.

description: Altria Group, Inc., through its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells smokeable and oral tobacco products in the United States. It offers cigarettes primarily under the Marlboro brand; large cigars and pipe tobacco under the Black & Mild brand; moist smokeless tobacco and oral tobacco products under the Copenhagen, Skoal, Red Seal, and Husky brands; oral nicotine pouches under the on! brand; and e-vapor products under the NJOY ACE brand. The company sells its products to distributors, as well as large retail organizations, such as chain stores. Altria Group, Inc. was founded in 1822 and is headquartered in Richmond, Virginia.
